prompt: Photographs visually dominated by irregular regions that spread, merge, fragment or recede across a surface or field, with mottled, ragged, feathered, branching or torn boundaries; visible materials and subjects may be unrelated.
exclusions: Known derivatives or related captures; illustrations, diagrams, synthetic textures; isolated objects, intact uniform surfaces, evenly repeated dots, distinct individual spots without patch merging, compositions dominated by architecture, horizon, people or a single large object rather than irregular patches.
looseness: Patches can be microscopic-looking or broad, high or low contrast, natural or manufactured, colorful or near monochrome; retain both contextual photographs and nearly abstract close views when the patchwork is visually conspicuous. A single central stain may fit if its boundary and satellite spread dominate.
interpretation: Curatorial visual resemblance only, no channel thresholds, semantic clusters, expected pairs, or membership ground truth. Discovery categories are search routes, not target groups.
publication_rule: Below 30 validated, independently screened, rights-reviewed acquired inputs after completed screening: abandon rather than pad. If 30+ accepted but acquisition fails or remains pending: incomplete_acquisition, never turn transport failure into visual rejection.
